FAQ On IT Staff Augmentation

What is IT Staff Augmentation?

Staff augmentation services allow engaging additional software developers, IT engineers, solution architects, QA specialists, etc. within your existing in-house or distributed team. It gives the ability to quickly meet the need to hire, save on hiring costs, and retain management control.

How quickly can we start working with your developers?

Having the best talent pool of pre-vetted professionals, we can help you quickly recruit the right talent, integrate and onboard them into your project. It commonly takes us less than 5 weeks to complete the hiring process for you.

What types of projects are suitable for IT Staff Augmentation?

There are commonly 2 types of projects that work best with this model: (1) when you need specific expertise, or (2) when you need to meet aggressive deadlines.

How do you ensure the quality of your developers?

We run a thorough talent selection process, including screening and hard & soft skill analysis. We have a proven track record and a strong in-house sourcing team, who ensures the proficiency and domain expertise of each developer. On request, we can also run tech interviews as a separate service to help you select only the most technically qualified specialists.

What is the difference between Staff Augmentation and Full Project Development Outsourcing?

Both models have their unique advantages. The outsourcing model works well when you want to fully delegate the whole development to an external team, giving them requirements at the project entrance and receiving the outcome at the exit. However, staff augmentation services allow boosting your in-house team and staying deeply involved in the process, facilitating any level of agility you may want to keep.

How do you handle the retention of remote developers?

Having worked for years in the industry, we developed an HR-friendly culture. We provide our remote developers with all necessary support and assistance to ensure everybody stays motivated and our best talents are retained long-term: from full HR and legal coverage, L&D, and online courses – to different engagement activities, such as corporate events, team building sessions, business trips, etc.

Can you handle the administrative and legal aspects of hiring?

Sure, this is what IT staff augmentation is all about. This model offers an effective way to augment your team, keeping you away from all administrative and legal activities. We set you up, while you sit back and run your development process.

What are the cost benefits of using IT Staff Augmentation?

Our fee already includes recruitment, benefits, insurance, infrastructure, hardware, and other related costs. That’s why this model is way more cost-effective than hiring in-house and offers the best price of quality.

Can you provide part-time or project-based developers?

Yes, we can. Offering 2 distinct service models to better fit your project requirements, Mobilunity can provide you with individual talents and a whole team of developers, based on the needs of your project (for example, to bring you a deeply specific expertise on a part-time basis or fill short-term job positions within days).

How do you handle time zone differences?

Our extensive talent network in top nearshore and offshore locations (Europe, North America, LATAM, MENA, Asia, and others) makes it possible to pick favorable time zone overlaps. You can leverage the benefits of geographical proximity and convenience – just as if we all worked together.

What support do you provide after integrating developers into our team?

Once onboarding and integration of your new team members is done, we keep an eye on your project – providing continuous support and personal maintenance. This includes performance monitoring, consultancy, and admin management.

How do you ensure a smooth onboarding process for new developers?

Recognizing onboarding as one of the most important stages of hiring, we closely cooperate with your new team members – ensuring cultural integration, setting regular and smooth check-ins, removing potential communication barriers, and aligning the development flow with your internal operations.
